description: Source code for a Product controller class in a MERN stack e-commerce application, handling product CRUD operations, image management, reviews, and filtering.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Controller class managing product operations such as add, edit, delete, retrieve, reviews, and image handling.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes images from the uploads directory based on provided filenames and mode.

methods.name: getAllProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all products with category information, sorted by ID descending.

methods.name: postAddProduct
methods.description: Adds a new product after validating input and images.

methods.name: postEditProduct
methods.description: Edits an existing product, updating details and images.

methods.name: getDeleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product and its associated images.

methods.name: getSingleProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a single product, including category and reviews.

methods.name: getProductByCategory
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getProductByPrice
methods.description: Fetches products priced below a specified value.

methods.name: getWishProduct
methods.description: Retrieves products based on an array of product IDs (wishlist).

methods.name: getCartProduct
methods.description: Retrieves products based on an array of product IDs (cart).

methods.name: postAddReview
methods.description: Adds a review and rating to a product, preventing duplicate reviews by the same user.

methods.name: deleteReview
methods.description: Removes a specific review from a product.
